title: Play On
tagline: Play ON is a decentralized app (DApp) that empowers street artists.
description: I used Next.js, leaned on several AIs for help, and, true to my style, broke, fixed, and broke things again many times. I focused on the essentials: live streaming and FLOW token donations with a small commission for the platform. It was a big challenge, but I learned a lot and I’m really happy with what I managed to build in such a short time.
how_its_made: I used Next.js and Tailwind for the frontend, integrated MetaMask for wallet connectivity, and used Blockscout to enable transparent transaction tracking. I also leaned on several AIs and, true to my style, broke, fixed, and broke things again many times. I focused on the essentials: FLOW token donations with a small commission for the platform. It was a big challenge.
